1. (Currently Amended) A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus below 100MPa, __wherein the elastomer is selected and configured to provide a resonant frequency below 300 Hz and to reduce sound degradation in the low frequency response__.

2. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises a silicone __having a Young's modulus below 100MPa__.

3. (Previously Presented) A speaker as claimed in claim 1 or 2, wherein the membrane (10) is injection moulded.

5. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1, 2, or 3, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the speaker further comprises a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane (10) to the coil (8), __and wherein the stiffening element is configured to control buckling and crinkling of the membrane__.

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Cancelled)

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Cancelled)

10. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus below 100MPa __selected to provide a resonant frequency below 300 Hz and to reduce sound degradation in the low frequency response__; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2).

11. (Currently Amended) A method as claimed in claim 10, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises silicone __having a Young's modulus below 100MPa__.

13. (Previously Presented) A method as claimed in claim 10 or 11, wherein the membrane (10) is formed using injection moulding.

14. (Currently Amended) A method as claimed in claim 10, 11, or 13, wherein the membrane (10) is formed with a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the method further comprises providing a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane to the coil (8), __wherein the stiffening element is configured to control buckling and crinkling of the membrane__.

4. (Currently Amended) A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus below 100MPa, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure.

12. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus below 100MPa; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2), wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure.
